title: Install and distribute
outcome: A team gets Garura into its project, upgrades it knowing what changes, and uses it on whichever coding tool it has.
why: A team can only use Garura once it's in their project, and only keeps using it if upgrades are safe.
proof: A first install takes one step.
An upgrade loses nothing the team changed.
Each tool gets what it supports.
must_not: Change what a project's people changed without asking them.

touches.title: Install Garura in one step, with a record of what it laid
Check that the installed Garura runs before the team uses it
Lay Garura's guardrails with the install
Update what the project gets as the project changes
Take Garura out of the project again
